name: Service QTriggerInfo (SA)
help: Query the start/stop trigger conditions for a Windows service
long_help: Retrieves trigger conditions that automatically start or stop a service, such as device arrival, IP address changes, domain join/leave, firewall events, or group policy updates. Equivalent to 'sc qtriggerinfo'.

arguments.name: hostname
arguments.desc: Target hostname or IP address (empty string for local machine)

arguments.name: servicename
arguments.desc: Service name to query (not display name)
